content.title: ‘Sabrinawood’ Takes Indio: Sabrina Carpenter’s Theatrical Coachella Headline Debut | 103.9 Wayne FM
content.text: × Sign In Search Home Concerts & Events News Local News Indiana News National News Music News Woman's Corner Connect Careers Contact Us Fifty / 50 Fridays Contest Rules Advertise Swag Now Playing The Promise When In Rome Image Press Agency / Depositphotos.com ‘Sabrinawood’ Takes Indio: Sabrina Carpenter’s Theatrical Coachella Headline Debut By Mariana A Apr 12, 2026 | 7:11 AM During her Friday night headline set at Coachella, Sabrina Carpenter turned the main stage into a full theatrical production with a movie-inspired concept called Sabrinawood. The performance mixed polished choreography, oversized visuals, scripted moments, and a fast-moving setlist that leaned into the glossy style of her recent era. Across 90 minutes, she moved through 20 songs while shifting between elaborate set pieces and multiple costume changes. At the festival in Indio, the show opened with a black-and-white film segment before expanding into a series of surprise appearances and staged transitions. Familiar faces appeared throughout the night, helping frame the set as part concert and part live pop fantasy. One of the most talked about moments came during a fake power outage that turned into another reveal onstage. Carpenter also gave We Almost Broke Up Last Night its first live performance, adding a new milestone to a set that marked her first time headlining Coachella and showed how far her live presentation has grown in a short time.
